verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows a first-party natural-language command interface, chat assistant or agent for operating Beglaubigt.de. The evidence covers REST endpoints, webhooks and llms.txt files that help LLMs read the docs. These are building blocks, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands. AI-powered signature-field detection is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
